A foundation service may only depend on brokers, exposures, or nothing.

Back to STXF rulesRead The Standard source

What The Standard says

A foundation service may only depend on brokers, exposures, or nothing. The analyser reports this as a warning at the declaration or statement that needs attention.

Why it matters

This rule belongs to the Foundation services family. Following it keeps responsibilities and intent visible to readers, tooling and future maintainers.

Bad code example

// Violates STXF002: A foundation service may only depend on brokers, exposures, or nothing.
class StudentService(IStudentProcessingService students) : IStudentService { }

Good code example

// Follows STXF002
class StudentService(IStudentBroker students) : IStudentService { }
